Z123 on BSC was attacked by a hacker due to a contract vulnerability, resulting in a loss of approximately $136k. The .update() function of Z123 was repeatedly called which burned extra tokens and inflated the price.

On April 22, 2024, the Z123 token contract on BNB Chain was exploited through flash loan,driven spot price manipulation. The attacker repeatedly swapped and manipulated pool reserves, misleading the contract’s price logic and extracting approximately $136,000 from liquidity pools. The Z123 contract used immediate pool reserve ratios as the source of truth for token price calculations. This logic allowed an attacker to conduct flash loan,fueled swaps and update cycles, artificially increasing the pool's spot price without any manipulation resistance, enabling value extraction.
